description: This file contains functions related to firmware upgrade and boot management for Linksys devices running OpenWrt, including retrieving target firmware information, performing upgrades, and copying configurations.

methods.name: linksys_get_target_firmware
methods.description: Determines the target firmware partition (`kernel1` or `kernel2`) based on the current active boot part, reading environment variables or filesystem info.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_linksys
methods.description: Performs the firmware upgrade process on Linksys devices by identifying the target partition, setting environment variables, and executing appropriate NAND upgrade commands based on firmware magic numbers.

methods.name: platform_copy_config_linksys
methods.description: Copies the backup configuration file to the temporary directory, ensuring it is available for restoration after upgrade.
